# agentcast

agentcast is the sub-agents component of the Energy meta-harness stack.

## Purpose

Owns three things:
1. A curated library of reusable Claude Code sub-agent persona files (.md)
2. A validator that enforces the flat .claude/agents/ path standard
3. A static eval that scores persona quality against a 5-dimension rubric

## The Flat-Path Standard

Claude Code resolves sub-agents from `.claude/agents/<name>.md` (flat, no nesting).
The anti-pattern `agents/agents/<name>.md` is rejected by the validator.

## Key Files

- `library/` — persona .md files (researcher, code-reviewer, test-writer, security-reviewer, architect, qa-tester)
- `validator/validate.mjs` — CLI: `node validator/validate.mjs --library`
- `eval/eval.mjs` — CLI: `node eval/eval.mjs --library`
- `.claude/agents/persona-auditor.md` — this repo's own sub-agent

## Provisional Status

Repo name "agentcast" is provisional — awaiting chairman confirmation or rename.
